evidence: The decomposition characteristics of TMG and arsine were analyzed using a quadrupole mass spectrometer with a capillary tube positioned 1 mm above the substrate surface for gas sampling. The carrier concentration of these epilayers was determined using Van der Pauw measurements. A surface profiler was used to measure the layer thickness from the step height at the selectively grown layer edge. The temperature dependence of quadrupole mass spectra intensity of Ga and methane was shown. The PL spectra of deep levels from epilayers grown at the ALE temperature of 490 0 C for different TMG fluxes were presented.
